title.narrative: EU support to confidence-building in the Western Balkans

description.narrative: The action aims at fostering mutual understanding and social cohesion through the promotion of accountability and fact-based dialogues about crimes committed during the 1990s conflicts on the territory of the former Yugoslavia. Through a multi[1]disciplinary approach, the action will (1) enhance the effective and efficient prosecution of war crimes at domestic level and (2) increase the shared understanding of the crimes committed during the 1990s conflicts on the territory of the former Yugoslavia.
